decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 14/11/2005, the use of the existing dwellinghouse for the receipt of mail and use of the fax, internet and computer in relation to the proposed chauffer business is ancillary to the property's use as a single family dwelling house and is lawful within the meaning of section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:
The proposed chauffeur operations within the dwellinghouse amount only to the receipt of mail and the use of a fax, internet and computer for receiving bookings, with no other internal or external alterations. There is to be no picking up or dropping off of customers at the site or the coming and goings of drivers to the premises. The nature and scale of the business is ancillary to the residential use, with the property remaining as a single-family dwellinghouse. There is no material change of use of part or whole of the dwellinghouse and therefore planning permission is not required.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the use of house to take telephone/fax bookings for chauffeur business.
